blocks.explanation:
Yahan upar bhi degree 2 hai aur neeche bhi degree 2, to fraction improper (ghalat kasr) hai.
Pehle is mein se poora hissa (quotient) nikalna hoga, phir jo proper remainder bachega us ke partial fractions Case I se banenge.
Plan: division, remainder ki identity, \(A\) aur \(B\), phir tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x^2 + 1}{(x + 1)(x - 1)}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Fraction improper hai, is liye pehle divide karte hain: fraction = quotient + proper fraction. Phir proper hisse ko Case I (do mukhtalif linear factors) se todte hain.

Proper ya improper check karein
\[(x + 1)(x - 1) = x^2 - 1\]
Upar ki degree 2 = neeche ki degree 2.
Kyun: Jab degrees barabar hon ya upar wali bari ho to fraction improper hota hai. Aise fraction ke seedhe partial fractions banane ki koshish karein to constants kabhi poore nahi baithte, is liye division pehle zaroori hai.

Divide karein
\[\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1} = \dfrac{(x^2 - 1) + 2}{x^2 - 1}\]
\[= 1 + \dfrac{2}{x^2 - 1}\]
Kyun: \(x^2 + 1\) ko \((x^2 - 1) + 2\) likhna long division hi ka chhota roop hai: quotient 1 aur remainder 2. Jab upar neeche ke bohat qareeb ho to yeh trick waqt bachati hai.

Proper hisse ki shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{2}{(x + 1)(x - 1)} = \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 1}\]
Kyun: Do mukhtalif linear factors, to do fractions, har ek par ek constant. Quotient 1 ko hum alag rakhte hain; woh aakhir mein jawab mein wapas aayega.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[2 = A(x + 1) + B(x - 1) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x + 1)(x - 1)\) se multiply kiya. Har constant ke saath woh factor reh gaya jo us ke apne fraction mein nahi tha.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[2 = A(2) + B(0)\]
\[A = 1\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) par \(x - 1 = 0\), is liye \(B\) wala term ghayab ho gaya aur \(A\) seedha mil gaya. Equations hal karne ki zaroorat hi nahi pari.

\(B\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -1\) rakhein
\[2 = A(0) + B(-2)\]
\[B = -1\]
Kyun: \(x = -1\) par \(x + 1 = 0\), to \(A\) wala term khatam.
Dhyan dein: \(B(-1 - 1) = -2B\); yahan minus chhoot jaye to poore jawab ke signs ulat jate hain, aur answer key mein bilkul yahi ghalti chhapi hai.

Coefficients compare karein
(i) ko kholein: \(2 = (A + B)x + (A - B)\).
\[x:\ A + B = 1 - 1 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\text{const}:\ A - B = 1 + 1 = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Identity mein dono taraf ek jaisi powers ke coefficients barabar hote hain. Is se pakka ho gaya ke \(A\) aur \(B\) sahi hain.

Jawab likhein
\[\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{(x + 1)(x - 1)} = 1 + \dfrac{1}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\]
Kyun: Quotient 1 wapas lagaya aur proper hisse mein \(A = 1\), \(B = -1\) rakh diye. Quotient bhool jana bohat aam ghalti hai, is liye jawab likhte waqt division wala step dobara dekh lein.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\[\dfrac{1}{x - 1} - \dfrac{1}{x + 1} = \dfrac{(x + 1) - (x - 1)}{x^2 - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{2}{x^2 - 1}\]
\[1 + \dfrac{2}{x^2 - 1} = \dfrac{x^2 - 1 + 2}{x^2 - 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 1} \;\checkmark\]
\(x = 0\) par chhota test: sawal \(= \tfrac{1}{-1} = -1\); jawab \(= 1 - 1 - 1 = -1\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Jor kar asal fraction wapas aa gaya. Number wala test sign ki ghalti foran pakar leta hai; imtihan mein yeh sirf aadha minute leta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(1 - \frac{1}{x - 1} + \frac{1}{x + 1}\) chhapa hai. Is mein dono fractions ke signs ulte hain: \(x = 0\) rakhein to key ka jawab \(1 + 1 + 1 = 3\) deta hai jab ke sawal \(-1\) deta hai. Durust jawab \(1 + \frac{1}{x - 1} - \frac{1}{x + 1}\) hai.
